name: Amaha Tsubasa
source:
Tsubasa represents the Aquarius. He's the moodmaker of the group. He has been living with his grandparents since he was little and loves inventing crazy things. He has a habit of coming up with nicknames for everybody.

[Edited from [url=http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Starry_Sky#Characters]Wikipedia[/url]]
